get.summary:
Readiness currently covers the API's database dependency only.
Provider and storage readiness must be included when those adapters are wired.

parameters.name: start_at
parameters.description: Zero-based match position, mutually exclusive with cursor.

id.description: File-level identity binds both snapshots and paths; not a review approval.

outdated_context.description: Compared to recorded database refs, never a live provider observation.

unresolved_blockers.description: Includes outdated threads and tombstoned messages.

prefix.description: Immutable source before this block, including its stable heading marker.

preamble.description: Exact YAML source, including unknown fields and original layout.

section_ids.description:
Includes headings nested inside lists/quotes, retaining duplicates so the
assembler can reject them across the complete document.

blocks.description: Complete new order. Missing old blocks require an explicit deletion below.

deleted_section_ids.description:
Includes IDs removed inside a changed list/quote, not just top-level
heading deletions. The caller must confirm incoming-reference validation.

removed_section_ids.description: Null when an invalid base/new source prevents a reliable comparison.

offset.description: UTF-8 offset in decoded text, not an offset in the original Markdown.

text_start_byte.description:
Decoded-event text coordinates. Original source coordinates remain on
event and can cover entities/escapes wider than this decoded fragment.

start_stack.description:
Original known Open events, outermost first. Consumers reopen these for
a standalone page and close end_stack in reverse without injecting HTML.

ImageEvidence.description:
ASCII-only identities and bounded display metadata. Serialized as unpadded
base64url JSON in X-Comparison-Image; the body is only re-encoded PNG pixels.

MatchWindow.description:
Visible text intervals within one document. Matching uses each entire block,
so a viewport/formatting boundary never changes literal-search semantics.

valid_for_stored_context.description: Database context and current eligibility only; provider refs are not read.

domains.description: Current caller assignments; each POST independently rechecks eligibility.

unviewed_content_warning.description: True when any eligible domain is unread/unknown, or no domain is eligible.

unviewed_domains.description:
Eligible domains with incomplete or unavailable acknowledged coverage.
These read facts do not confer section approval or permission to merge.

item_start.description: Starting item number when reopening this list at the window boundary.

changed_documents.description: Unknown until an actual diff has been computed; equal base/head is exactly zero.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset in this chunk's nonempty text (old text for equal).

old_start_column_bytes.description:
Byte columns, not grapheme, display or UTF-16 columns. A nonzero column
signals a window continuing inside a line; UTF-8 scalars are never split.

returned_text_bytes.description: Sum of both source-text fields, before JSON escaping. Equal text counts twice.

ReviewBeforeMediaEvidence.description:
Before-media derives from a verified document reference and pinned base-tree
entry. It is not an after receipt or a newly published review manifest.

ReviewBookDocument.description:
Complete head-book identity, including documents absent from the diff.
Deserializing this read model does not construct a source proof.

ReviewCoverage.description: Current caller's exact snapshot/domain read evidence, never approval authority.

available.description: False for legacy snapshots without a complete sealed requirement set.

unviewed_units.description: Includes partial and unsupported items, without treating them as viewed.

ReviewMediaEvidence.description:
Source identities are server-resolved from the sealed media receipt. The
image.file_id is a domain-separated media identity, not a changed-file ID.

number.description: Decimal string avoids losing provider identity in JavaScript numbers.

recorded_at.description: Database receipt time, not the time of a new provider read by this GET.

current_for_sync.description: Current DB metadata/editable state only; provider refs are not read here.

oneOf.description: Last stored observation for this PR; it may refer to another snapshot.

A current admin may request this recovery mode. The POST rechecks all
authority and journal conditions; this hint grants no mutation authority.

uncertain_write.description: Any unresolved started PR write for this proposal, including older work.

automatic.description: Planned automatic work, not proof that a worker/provider is available.

ReviewPublication.description: Durable snapshot outcome; PR synchronization and approvals are separate.

current_metadata.description: Current database metadata only; does not assert fresh Git refs or approval.

available.description: False for legacy snapshots without a sealed complete-book manifest.

ReviewSnapshotUnits.description: Mandatory source metadata only; reading a page does not record a visit or approval.

available.description: False for legacy snapshots without a sealed requirement manifest.

expected_draft_version.description: Zero creates a buffer; existing live buffers require their returned version.

can_edit.description:
This preview can also compare recovery against a historical/closed base.
Actual writes must independently enforce current Git/state/version gates.

TextSelection.description:
A browser selects identities and bounded lines, never a path, Git ref, source
body, quote, digest or byte offset. The document identity comes from the
verified manifest and is checked again against actual source front matter.

id.description:
Versioned derived identity binds both complete source hashes and units.
A serving/review layer must additionally bind file/snapshot and scope.

position_changed.description: Absolute ordinal difference, not a claim about which move was intended.

render_changed.description: None means render equivalence is unknown (e.g. protected source).
